subject: Vendor governance & onboarding evidence for SIG/CAIQ review
messages:
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@meditrust.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: security@meditrust.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor governance & onboarding evidence for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. As part of our vendor assessment ahead of the procurement committee next week, our security team needs a compact evidence bundle that maps to SIG/CAIQ and verifies subprocessor handling for inference workloads. Can you provide the following by EOD Tue, Sep 15 (Meditrust deadline):

- Current subprocessor roster with roles/residency and which handle customer data (CSV or spreadsheet).
- The most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redacted if necessary) and the auditor contact.
- Completed CAIQ responses or a pointer to your CAIQ pack.
- SBOM for the inference runtime (libraries & versions) or a vendor SBOM summary.
- KMS/key residency map (which providers have custody and region residency).
- A high-level dataflow diagram for customer inference requests (where tokens/outputs traverse, caching, and any egress points).
- Retention & deletion policy for logs/requests and whether you perform token-level retention for hosted/dedicated/private modes.
- Any standard contractual clauses or exceptions we should be aware of for the inference product (e.g., subprocessors, onshore/offshore processing).

We will upload anything you send to our secure intake (see attached upload template) and may request follow-ups for artifacts we need signed/attested. If there are items you cannot share, please indicate whether you can provide an attestation letter or a SOC-bridging statement.

Attachment: Meditrust_SIG_Template.xlsx (request matrix)

Appreciate your help — procurement committee meets 9/16 so timing is tight.

Best,
Alice
Alice Gomez
Head of Vendor Security, Meditrust
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@meditrust.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, security@meditrust.com
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor governance & onboarding evidence for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list and the template. We're on it and can deliver a redacted bundle plus attestations by end of day Tue (9/15). Below is an annotated summary and owners; full artifacts will be attached/uploaded to your secure intake link unless you prefer a pre-signed S3 share.

Quick answers (high-level):
- Subprocessor roster: will provide CSV with role, processing purpose, region, and whether the processor touches customer payloads. Owner: jordan_blake (will deliver).
- SOC 2 Type II: we can share the 2026 report with standard redactions (no customer-identifiable content). Owner: naomi_feldman.
- CAIQ/SIG: we will include our completed CAIQ PDF and a short mapping doc that highlights controls relevant to inference (KV cache, batching, model telemetry). Owner: karthik_iyer.
- SBOM: inference runtime SBOM (libraries & pinned versions) — Jordan will extract and provide an SBOM CSV plus a short caveat about build-time vs runtime components. Owner: jordan_blake.
- KMS/key residency: Ben will deliver a YAML mapping of KMS providers, regions, and whether keys are customer-managed (Dedicated/Private) or Redwood-managed (Hosted). Owner: ben_carter.
- Dataflow diagram: we'll include a labeled PNG showing ingress, model serving, caching layers, telemetry paths, and optional egress to partner services. Owner: jordan_blake.
- Retention policy: we'll attach the official retention/deletion policy and a short note on token retention differences between Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Owner: naomi_feldman.
- Contractual notes: we'll point to our standard DPA excerpt and call out any exceptions for on-prem deployments. Owner: naomi_feldman.

Attachments we will include: redwood_subprocessor_roster_20260915.csv, SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026_redacted.pdf, CAIQ_responses_2026.pdf, sbom_inference_runtime_20260914.csv, kms_residency_map_20260914.yaml, dataflow_inference_diagram_20260914.png, retention_policy_2026.pdf

Upload preference: can you confirm whether you want us to upload directly into your intake workbook (Meditrust_SIG_Template.xlsx) or should we provide a secure pre-signed link? If you send the intake link we will push the files there and mark the corresponding rows. If you prefer pre-signed links, we will attach a single zip with a 7-day expiry.

One ask: for any items where we provide an attestation vs full artifact (for IP reasons), would you accept a short signed letter from our Security & Legal teams? Example: a minimal SBOM redaction or a derived SBOM summary for proprietary components.

We aim to deliver the bundle by Tue EOD (9/15) and can do a 20-minute walkthrough with your security folks on Wed morning if needed.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor governance & onboarding evidence for SIG/CAIQ review

On it — I'll pull the KMS/residency exports and annotate which keys are customer-managed vs Redwood-managed.

Notes for the bundle:
- I need access to KeyOps Export folder (KeyOps/exports/2026) to generate the residency map; Jordan, can you grant me read access to the runtime build manifests so I can correlate key usage with deployed instances?
- For Dedicated customers we have customer-controlled KMS entries; I will mark those explicitly in kms_residency_map_20260914.yaml.
- Ephemeral keys: we should state that short-lived ephemeral keys are used for prefix caching in hosted mode; confirm whether Meditrust needs a separate attestation for ephemeral key lifecycle.

ETA: I'll upload kms_residency_map_20260914.yaml and a short readme to the shared artifacts folder by Tue 18:00 PST.

–Ben
Ben Carter
Security Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@meditrust.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, security@meditrust.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Governance & evidence bundle for Meditrust (SIG/CAIQ)

Hi Alice — attaching the bundle we discussed. Per your intake template, we've mapped each requested item to the corresponding deliverable. If you need signed attestations for anything redacted, let me know and I will route to Legal/Security for signature.

Delivered items (attached/uploaded):
- redwood_subprocessor_roster_20260915.csv (roles, processing purpose, residency, handles_customer_payload boolean)
- SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026_redacted.pdf (redactions: internal employee names and customer samples)
- CAIQ_responses_2026.pdf (completed questionnaire; calls out inference-specific controls)
- sbom_inference_runtime_20260914.csv (runtime dependencies, versions — build-time components redacted)
- kms_residency_map_20260914.yaml (provider, region, customer-managed flag)
- dataflow_inference_diagram_20260914.png (high-level diagram of request path and caching)
- retention_policy_2026.pdf (policy excerpt called out in the intake template)

Access method: Uploaded to your secure intake. Link (for your convenience): https://meditrust-secure.example.com/intake/REDWOOD-20260915 (requires Meditrust SSO). If you prefer pre-signed links instead, we can also provide a single zip with 7-day expiry — tell us which you prefer.

Two clarifications you may see in the bundle:
1) SBOM redaction: we provide a runtime SBOM; build-time/private third-party patches are summarized and we offer an attestation letter for the omitted sections.
2) Ephemeral key lifecycle: documented in kms_residency_map readme; if you require a separate attestation that ephemeral keys are rotated within 24 hours for hosted deployments, we can provide a signed statement.

Next steps: if the committee needs anything further before 9/16, please flag the specific rows in your intake sheet and we'll prioritize. If helpful, Ben & Jordan are available for a 20-minute call Wed 9/16 08:00–10:00 PST.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_roster_20260915.csv; SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026_redacted.pdf; CAIQ_responses_2026.pdf; sbom_inference_runtime_20260914.csv; kms_residency_map_20260914.yaml; dataflow_inference_diagram_20260914.png; retention_policy_2026.pdf
